newsitem.title: UK: NWE high sulphur straight-run fuel oil weak.
newsitem.headline: NWE high sulphur straight-run fuel oil weak.

text.p: NWE high sulphur straight-run fuel oil was weaker on Wednesday, despite stronger crude, because of continued good supply from the Baltics, traders said.
A very prompt E-4 cargo, on the vessel Moskovskiy Festival, was heard sold to an ARA player at around $110 cif.
A prompt M-40 on the Janis Sudrabkains was heard sold to a trader at around $95 cif NWE.
Traders said an E-4 cargo, on the Blue Star, was likely to head for the Mediterranean because of poor demand in NWE. Offers of E-4 were heard at discounts to the mean/mean/mean of published quotes.
An ARA refiner bought an E-4 earlier in the week at a p+c price.
